title: Gnome Techno Wizard
description: A fierce gnome-like character with red and yellow hair, glowing blue goggles, and a long white beard stands dynamically on a stone ledge. He wields a large glowing blue technological staff emitting energy beams while a mechanical cannon on his leg fires simultaneously, set against a dramatic background of explosions, flying debris, and ruined architecture.
prompt: A dynamic fantasy gnome character with fiery red and yellow hair, long white beard, and glowing blue mechanical goggles, wearing ornate purple and gold armor, standing on a broken stone ledge in a ruined city. He dual wields a large glowing blue technological staff emitting energy rings and beams, with a large mechanical steampunk cannon on his leg firing a bright blue laser. Dramatic background shows massive orange explosions, flying debris, papers, and broken buildings under a dark sky, high detail cinematic fantasy art
